test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Prajakta is a very __vain__ girl.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vain"** means having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth. (घमंडी)

 
 
• **Example: **She is so vain that she spends hours in front of the mirror.
 
 
 
• **"Humble"** refers to having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his success, he remains a humble person.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'vain'** is **'humble'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honourable** (सम्माननीय): Deserving respect or high regard.

 
 
• **Example:** He is known as an honourable judge in the court.
 
 
 
• **Hopeful** (आशावान): Feeling or inspiring optimism about a future event.
 
 
• **Example:** She is hopeful that she will get the job.
 
 
 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Free of deceit; truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** He is known for being an honest businessman.
